components.title: Filter out cancelled orders
components.what: Exclude only rows whose status is 'cancelled'; include pending and shipped orders.

components.title: Compute per-order revenue
components.what: For each included order, calculate revenue as units multiplied by unit_price.

components.title: Sum revenue by region
components.what: Add the included order revenues for each region: West, North, South, and East.

components.title: Find top two regions' difference
components.what: Identify the highest and second-highest regional totals, subtract the second from the highest, and round the resulting dollar difference to the nearest cent.

asked: Please recompute, independently and digit by digit, 34 x 108.79 and 40 x 79.06, and state the exact unrounded West subtotal and exact unrounded South subtotal; does any intermediate rounding occur before the final subtraction, and would the difference change if products were kept at full precision?
replies:
Independent computations:
34 × 108.79 = (30 × 108.79) + (4 × 108.79) = 3263.70 + 435.16 = 3698.86.
40 × 79.06 = (4 × 79.06) × 10 = 316.24 × 10 = 3162.40.
Using the listed non-cancelled orders, the exact West subtotal is 1396.60 + 3698.86 + 3162.40 + 493.30 = 8751.16. The exact South subtotal is 1711.22 + 408.08 + 832.50 + 52.80 = 3004.60.
No intermediate rounding occurs before the final subtraction; each product is exact to cents because units are integers and unit prices have two decimal places. Keeping products at full precision would not change the difference: 8751.16 − 3004.60 = 5746.56. The submitted answer is correct.
